option.name: --addtag
tip: Adds a tag to a PV, VG or LV.

option.name: --alloc
tip: Determines the allocation policy when a command needs to allocate Physical Extents (PEs) from the VG.

option.name: --autobackup
tip: Specifies if metadata should be backed up automatically after a change.

option.name: --clustered
tip: This option was specific to clvm and is now replaced by the --shared option with lvmlockd(8).

option.name: --commandprofile
tip: The command profile to use for command configuration.

option.name: --config
tip: Config settings for the command.

option.name: --dataalignment
tip: Align the start of a PV data area with a multiple of this number.

option.name: --dataalignmentoffset
tip: Shift the start of the PV data area by this additional offset.

option.name: --debug
tip: Set debug level.

option.name: --devices
tip: Restricts the devices that are visible and accessible to the command.

option.name: --devicesfile
tip: A file listing devices that LVM should use.

option.name: --driverloaded
tip: If set to no, the command will not attempt to use device-mapper.

option.name: --force
tip: Override various checks, confirmations and protections.

option.name: --help
tip: Display help text.

option.name: --journal
tip: Record information in the systemd journal.

option.name: --labelsector
tip: By default the PV is labelled with an LVM2 identifier in its second sector (sector 1).

option.name: --lockopt
tip: Used to pass options for special cases to lvmlockd.

option.name: --locktype
tip: Specify the VG lock type directly in place of using --shared.

option.name: --longhelp
tip: Display long help text.

option.name: --maxlogicalvolumes
tip: Sets the maximum number of LVs allowed in a VG.

option.name: --maxphysicalvolumes
tip: Sets the maximum number of PVs that can belong to the VG.

option.name: --metadatacopies
tip: Number of copies of the VG metadata that are kept.

option.name: --metadataprofile
tip: The metadata profile to use for command configuration.

option.name: --metadatasize
tip: The approximate amount of space used for each VG metadata area.

option.name: --metadatatype
tip: Specifies the type of on-disk metadata to use.

option.name: --nohints
tip: Do not use the hints file to locate devices for PVs.

option.name: --nolocking
tip: Disable locking.

option.name: --physicalextentsize
tip: Sets the physical extent size of PVs in the VG.

option.name: --profile
tip: An alias for --commandprofile or --metadataprofile, depending on the command.

option.name: --pvmetadatacopies
tip: The number of metadata areas to set aside on a PV for storing VG metadata.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Suppress output and log messages.

option.name: --reportformat
tip: Overrides current output format for reports which is defined globally by the report/output_format setting in lvm.conf(5).

option.name: --setautoactivation
tip: Set the autoactivation property on a VG or LV.

option.name: --shared
tip: Create a shared VG using lvmlockd if LVM is compiled with lockd support.

option.name: --systemid
tip: Specifies the system ID that will be given to the new VG, overriding the system ID of the host running the command.

option.name: --test
tip: Run in test mode.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Set verbose level.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version information.

option.name: --vgmetadatacopies
tip: Number of copies of the VG metadata that are kept.

option.name: --yes
tip: Do not prompt for confirmation interactively but always assume the answer yes.

option.name: --zero
tip: Controls if the first 4 sectors (2048 bytes) of the device are wiped.
